title: Harry Potter og Mysteriekammeret
author: J. K. Rowling
note: conf=0.97; ISBN 9781781107461 matches the Norwegian-language ebook edition of Harry Potter og Mysteriekammeret (Pottermore Publishing, 23 Aug 2016), the Norwegian translation (by Torstein Bugge Høverstad) of Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets — book 2 of the Harry Potter series. Ark.no lists it under the Harry Potter series. Filename drops the final -t ("Mysteriekammere"); canonical title per metadata/retailers is "Harry Potter og Mysteriekammeret".
